name: Pan-Seared Salmon & Cheddar Polenta (or Grits)
whyItWorks: Salmon flakes apart with zero tough connective tissue; corn grits/polenta cook down completely smooth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear skinless salmon bites or fillet with a sweet soy or teriyaki glaze. Serve over soft-cooked quick corn grits stirred with butter and sharp cheddar or grated parmesan.
